title: Christ Has Set Us Free, Keep in Step with the Spirit

questions.question: For ____ Christ has set us free; stand firm therefore, and do not submit again to a yoke of slavery.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:1 (ESV): "For freedom Christ has set us free; stand firm therefore, and do not submit again to a yoke of slavery."

questions.question: Look: I, Paul, say to you that if you accept circumcision, Christ will be of no ____ to you.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:2 (ESV): "Look: I, Paul, say to you that if you accept circumcision, Christ will be of no advantage to you."

questions.question: Paul testifies to every man who accepts circumcision that he is obligated to keep the ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:3 (ESV): "I testify again to every man who accepts circumcision that he is obligated to keep the whole law."

questions.question: You are severed from Christ, you who would be justified by the law; you have fallen away from ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:4 (ESV): "You are severed from Christ, you who would be justified by the law; you have fallen away from grace."

questions.question: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision counts for anything, but only faith working through ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:6 (ESV): "For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision counts for anything, but only faith working through love."

questions.question: You were running well. Who hindered you from obeying the ____?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:7 (ESV): "You were running well. Who hindered you from obeying the truth?"

questions.question: Paul states, "A little ____ leavens the whole lump." (A proverb also used in 1 Corinthians).
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:9 (ESV): "A little leaven leavens the whole lump."

questions.question: Paul wishes that those who unsettle them would ____ themselves!
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:12 (ESV): "I wish those who unsettle you would emasculate themselves!"

questions.question: For you were called to freedom, brothers. Only do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the ____, but through love serve one another.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:13 (ESV): "For you were called to freedom, brothers. Only do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love serve one another."

questions.question: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word: "You shall love your ____ as yourself."
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:14 (ESV): "For the whole law is fulfilled in one word: 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.'"

questions.question: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:16 (ESV): "But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh."

questions.question: Now the works of the flesh are evident. Which of the following is NOT listed in verses 19-21 among the works of the flesh?
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:19-21 lists many works of the flesh (sexual immorality, impurity, sensuality, idolatry, sorcery, enmity, strife, jealousy, fits of anger, rivalries, dissensions, divisions, envy, drunkenness, orgies). "Lying" is not explicitly mentioned in this specific list.

questions.question: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, ____, gentleness, self-control.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:22-23 (ESV): "But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control; against such things there is no law."

questions.question: Against such things (the fruit of the Spirit) there is no ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:23 (ESV): "...gentleness, self-control; against such things there is no law."

questions.question: And those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its ____ and desires.
questions.explanation: Galatians 5:24 (ESV): "And those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires."

key_verse_text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control; against such things there is no law.
